Class DialogueRuntimeGraph

The runtime representation of a dialogue graph.

Inheritance
object
DialogueRuntimeGraph
Namespace: SF.DialogueModule.Nodes
Assembly: SF.Packages.dll
Syntax
[Serializable]
public class DialogueRuntimeGraph
Remarks

This is built from a list of dialogue nodes from the editor graph asset See SFEditor.Dialogue.Graphs.DialogueGraphImporter. Go to the editor assembly folder for the dialogue system to find the class.

Constructors

DialogueRuntimeGraph()

Called everytime the DialogueGraphImporter runs. This means on opening Unity as well and script comping/reloading domain.

Remarks

The constructor is called during an ScriptedImporter. See SFEditor.Dialogue.Graphs.DialogueGraphImporter. so we do not say public List{IRuntimeNode} Nodes = new(); If this is done than the scripted imported will erase the SerializeReference nodes when opening Unity losing all data.
